map.租房押金纠纷辅助 使用指南: Rental Deposit Dispute Assistant User Guide
map.租房押金纠纷辅助工具梳理常见押金扣减情形与法律依据，给出退费与举证参考，适合租客: The Rental Deposit Dispute Assistant tool organises common deposit deduction cases and the legal basis, giving reference for refunds and evidence. It suits tenants defending their rights, landlord compliance and mediation of rental disputes.
map.退租时核对房东可合法扣减的项目（欠租、实际损坏），估算应退押金。: On moving out, check which items the landlord may lawfully deduct (rent arrears, actual damage) and estimate the deposit that should be returned.
map.识别无依据扣减（如无正当理由清洁费、正常磨损），主张全额退还。: Identify deductions without basis (such as an unjustified cleaning fee or normal wear) and demand a full refund.
map.对拒不退还的，提示可起诉并主张 LPR 逾期利息。: If the landlord refuses to return it, point out that you can sue and claim overdue interest at the LPR.
map.：押金 6000 元，欠租 3000 元有证据可扣，应退 3000 元；房东另以: With a deposit of 6000 CNY and rent arrears of 3000 CNY that can be evidenced, 3000 should be returned; the landlord deducting a further 800 CNY as a "cleaning fee" without a contractual basis is unlawful, and the tool flags that it should not be counted.
map.：墙面轻微污渍属正常使用损耗，不得从押金扣除；仅因承租人过错造成的损坏按折旧后价: Light stains on walls are normal use wear and cannot be deducted from the deposit; only damage caused by the tenant's fault is compensated at the depreciated value.
map.退房清洁费能扣押金吗？: Can the cleaning fee be deducted from the deposit on move-out?
map.合同无明确约定且房屋无异常脏乱的，日常清洁费一般不得向租客收取；确有超出正常的清: With no explicit agreement in the contract and no abnormal dirtiness, routine cleaning fees generally cannot be charged to the tenant; if there really is cleaning beyond normal use, the actual expenditure has to be evidenced.
map.房东不退押金怎么办？: What do I do if the landlord won't refund the deposit?
map.可协商、向住建/街道调解，或持合同、转账记录、交房证据起诉，并主张按 LPR 计: Negotiation, mediation via the housing authority or the sub-district office, or filing a lawsuit with the contract, transfer records and handover evidence, and claiming overdue interest calculated at the LPR.
